import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Top 10 dog breeds by count
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    ax1.text(bar.get_width() + 20, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{breed_counts.values[i]:,}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog distribution by district
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
district_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
colors = plt.cm.tab20c(np.linspace(0, 1, len(district_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(district_counts.values, labels=district_counts.index, 
                                   colors=colors, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                   textprops={'fontsize': 8})
ax2.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. Dog age distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
age_order = df['AlterVHundLang'].dropna().unique()
age_order = sorted(age_order, key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else 0)
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex(age_order)
bars = ax3.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, color='skyblue')
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Dog Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 50,
             f'{height:,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8, rotation=0)

# 4. Gender distribution of dogs
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                   colors=colors, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Dog registration trend over years
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
year_counts = df['StichtagDatJahr'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax5.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=8, color='#2E86AB')
ax5.fill_between(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='#2E86AB')
ax5.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Dog Registration Trend (2015-2025)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
for x, y in zip(year_counts.index, year_counts.values):
    ax5.text(x, y + 100, f'{y:,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# 6. Owner age distribution
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
owner_age_counts = df['AlterV10Lang'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars = ax6.bar(range(len(owner_age_counts)), owner_age_counts.values, color='#FFA07A')
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(owner_age_counts)))
ax6.set_xticklabels(owner_age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Owners', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Dog Owner Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax6.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 50,
             f'{height:,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8, rotation=0)

# 7. Top dog colors
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
color_counts = df['HundefarbeText'].value_counts().head(8)
bars = ax7.barh(range(len(color_counts)), color_counts.values, color='#9B59B6')
ax7.set_yticks(range(len(color_counts)))
ax7.set_yticklabels(color_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax7.invert_yaxis()
ax7.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Most Common Dog Colors', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    ax7.text(bar.get_width() + 20, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{color_counts.values[i]:,}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 8. Dogs per owner (AnzHunde distribution)
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
dog_per_owner = df['AnzHunde'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars = ax8.bar(dog_per_owner.index, dog_per_owner.values, color='#27AE60', width=0.6)
ax8.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs per Owner', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Number of Owners', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_title('Dogs per Owner Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xticks(dog_per_owner.index)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax8.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 50,
             f'{height:,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# 9. Mixed vs Pure Breed
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
mixed_breed = df['Rasse2Text'].notna().sum()
pure_breed = len(df) - mixed_breed
labels = ['Pure Breed', 'Mixed Breed']
values = [pure_breed, mixed_breed]
colors = ['#E74C3C', '#3498DB']
bars = ax9.bar(labels, values, color=colors)
ax9.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_title('Pure Breed vs Mixed Breed Dogs', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    percentage = (height / len(df)) * 100
    ax9.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 100,
             f'{height:,}\n({percentage:.1f}%)', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# Adjust layout and add main title
plt.suptitle('Zurich Dog Registration Analysis\nComprehensive Overview of Canine Population', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
